info.name: AgroConnect API
info.description:
Complete collection for testing AgroConnect API endpoints, including Phase 7 messaging, Phase 8 offers, Phase 9 orders/payments, Phase 10 transport and delivery, Phase 11 notifications, and Phase 12 reviews/verification/trust.

## Setup
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Select the **AgroConnect Local** environment (or create one).
3. Set `base_url` to `http://localhost:5000/api` for local development.
4. Work through the folders in order:
   - **Health** — verify the server is running
   - **Auth / Registration** — create accounts
   - **Auth / Verification** — verify phone and email
   - **Auth / Login & Session** — log in and manage tokens
   - **Auth / Protected** — test authenticated endpoints
   - **Phase 7 — Messaging** — test conversations and messages
   - **Phase 8 — Offers & Negotiation** — test offer creation, counters, lifecycle, and history
   - **Phase 9 — Orders, Reservations & Paystack Payments** — test order creation, reservations, hosted checkout, verification, webhooks, and refunds
   - **Phase 10 — Transport & Delivery** — test transporter profiles, delivery requests, assignment, lifecycle and tracking history
   - **Phase 11 — Notifications** — test the inbox, preferences, unread counts, admin delivery logs and retries
   - **Phase 12 — Reviews, Moderation, Verification & Trust** — test reviews, report moderation, structured verification, private document access and trust profiles

## Variables automatically captured
- `user_id` — set by the Register requests
- `access_token` — set by Login and Refresh
- `otp` — set manually after checking server console (dev adapter logs to stdout)
- `offer_id` — set by Create offer (listing)
- `buyer_request_offer_id` — set by Create offer (buyer request)
- `counter_offer_id` — set by Counter offer
- `order_id` — set by Create order from accepted offer
- `payment_reference` — set by Initialize Paystack payment
- `refund_id` — set by Request full refund
- `transporter_profile_id` — set by Create transporter profile
- `delivery_id` — set by Create delivery request
- `notification_id` — set by List notifications
- `notification_delivery_id` — set by List admin notification deliveries
- `admin_access_token` — set manually from an admin account

item.name: Phase 7 — Messaging
item.description: One-to-one conversations, persistent messages, unread counts and read receipts. Set `participant_user_id` to the other user's ID before creating a conversation. Realtime Socket.IO events are separate from these REST calls: connect with `auth: { token: <access_token> }`, then emit `conversation:join`, `message:send`, `message:delivered` and `message:read`. The REST API remains the authoritative history.

request.description: Create a one-to-one conversation. The participant pair and optional marketplace context are deduplicated. Use a participant/context you have not already used to receive 201; duplicates return 409.
List conversations where the authenticated user is a participant. Supports `status=active|archived|blocked|all`, `page` and `limit`.
Read conversation metadata, participants, last message and the current user's unread count. Non-participants receive 404.
Send a text message to an active conversation. The sender is always derived from the access token; clients cannot impersonate another user.
Read paginated message history. Supports `before` (ISO 8601), `order=asc|desc`, `page` and `limit`.
Mark messages read. Omit `message_id` to mark everything up to now, or supply a specific message ID to mark up to that message.
Return total unread messages and a per-conversation unread breakdown.
Archive a conversation. Messaging is blocked while archived.
Return an archived conversation to active.
Block a conversation. Messaging is blocked while blocked. Unarchive before blocking an archived conversation.
Return a blocked conversation to active. Unblock before unarchiving a blocked conversation.

item.name: Phase 8 — Offers & Negotiation
item.description: Structured offers on published listings or open buyer requests, with recipient-only accept/reject/counter, creator-only withdraw, negotiation history, expiry, and audit events. Set `listing_id` or `buyer_request_id` manually. Create an offer while authenticated as the buyer for a listing offer, or as the farmer for a buyer-request offer. Set `offer_recipient_token` to the other participant's access token for accept, reject, and counter. Accepting an offer does not reserve inventory or create an order.

request.description: Create an offer as the buyer on a published listing owned by another user. The listing unit and currency must match the payload. Omit `expires_at` to use the 72-hour default.

body.raw:
{
  "listing_id": "{{listing_id}}",
  "buyer_request_id": null,
  "conversation_id": null,
  "quantity": 10,
  "unit": "kg",
  "unit_price": 500,
  "currency": "NGN",
  "delivery_terms": "Buyer collects from the farm gate.",
  "delivery_location": "Jos, Plateau State",
  "delivery_date": null,
  "buyer_message": "Is this lot still available?"
}

request.description: Create an offer as the farmer against an open buyer request owned by another user. The request unit and currency must match the payload.

body.raw:

  "listing_id": null,

request.description: List offers sent and received by the authenticated user. Supports role, direction, status, listing_id, buyer_request_id, conversation_id, sort, page, and limit.
Read an offer. Only the buyer and farmer participants can access it; non-participants receive 404.
Return the full negotiation thread (root, counters, and the current offer) plus immutable offer_events audit rows.
Accept a pending offer as its recipient. Acceptance re-validates the listing or buyer request and current available quantity. It does not reserve inventory or create an order.
Reject a pending offer as its recipient. Rejected offers cannot be accepted later.
Withdraw a pending offer as its creator. Only the creator can withdraw.
Counter a pending offer as its recipient. The parent becomes countered and a linked child offer is created. A thread is limited to 20 offers.

  "quantity": 8,

  "delivery_date": null,

request.description: Owner-only: list offers for a listing owned by the authenticated user.
Owner-only: list offers against a buyer request owned by the authenticated user.

item.name: Phase 9 — Orders, Reservations & Paystack Payments
item.description: Create orders from accepted listing offers, reserve inventory atomically, initialize and verify Paystack hosted checkout, process signed webhooks, and request refunds. Create and accept a Phase 8 listing offer first so `offer_id` is captured. The offer creator is normally the buyer and `offer_recipient_token` is the farmer. Orders cannot be created from buyer-request-only offers because they have no listing inventory. Paystack provider calls require `PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY`; use test keys and never commit real credentials.

request.description: Create an order as the buyer from an accepted listing offer. The server locks the offer and listing, re-validates stock, and atomically reserves inventory. New orders start at pending_payment/pending. The `order_id` is saved for later requests.
List orders where the authenticated user is buyer or farmer. Supports role, status, payment_status, listing_id, offer_id, sort, page and limit.
Read one order. Only the buyer and farmer participants can access it; non-participants receive 404.
Read the immutable order_events audit trail for the order.

Advance fulfillment as the farmer: paid → processing → ready_for_delivery → in_transit → delivered. Change the body status to the next allowed step. The buyer uses the same endpoint to mark delivered → completed.

Cancel a pending_payment or payment_failed order as a participant. The active reservation is released or removed according to freshness, pending payment attempts are abandoned, and an order event is recorded. Paid orders must be refunded instead.
Read the inventory reservation attached to the order, including quantity, status and expiry.
List inventory reservations visible to the authenticated buyer or farmer. Supports status, order_id, listing_id, page and limit.

Initialize or reuse a pending Paystack hosted checkout for the order as the buyer. The server uses the order total in minor units and returns an authorization URL and reference. `payment_reference` is saved. Requires PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY.
Verify the payment with Paystack as the buyer and apply the provider result idempotently. On success the reservation is consumed and the order becomes paid. Requires PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY.
List payment attempts for the order as a participant.

Request a full refund of a successful payment as a participant. Omit amount to refund the remaining balance. Provider acceptance is not treated as processed; the status is reconciled immediately and on later reads. A fully processed refund restores consumed reservation stock when eligible.
Request a partial refund in major currency units. Partial refunds update payment and order refund status without changing inventory.
List refunds for the payment and reconcile pending or processing refunds with Paystack.

Reference request for the raw-body Paystack webhook endpoint. Paystack calls this URL directly; it is not Bearer-authenticated. Send header `Paystack-Signature: t=<unix-seconds>,v1=<key-id>:<hmac-sha512>` (or legacy `x-paystack-signature`). The signed payload is `t + "." + raw_body`. Do not send a JSON Authorization header.
Create the authenticated user's transporter profile. New profiles start pending/unavailable and are assigned the transporter role automatically.

{
  "business_name": "Jos Fresh Logistics",
  "contact_phone": "+2348031234567",
  "operating_location": "Jos, Plateau State",
  "coverage_areas": [
    "Jos South",
    "Jos North"

  "vehicle_registration_number": "PL-123-ABC",
  "vehicle_capacity": "5 tonnes",
  "produce_types": [
    "maize",

exec: pm.test('Get my transporter profile OK', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Update the authenticated transporter profile. Availability can only be set to available after admin approval.
Read a transporter profile. Pending profiles are visible only to their owner and administrators.
Administrator approves a pending transporter profile.
Administrator suspends a transporter profile and marks it unavailable.
Administrator reactivates a suspended transporter profile.
Create a delivery request for an eligible paid order. Only the buyer or farmer participant can create it. Quantity, unit, location, date and currency must match the order.

{
  "order_id": "{{order_id}}",
  "pickup_location": "Bukuru Farm Gate, Jos South",
  "delivery_location": "Bukuru, Jos South",
  "produce_description": "Fresh maize in good condition",
  "quantity": 10,
  "unit": "kg",
  "expected_pickup_date": "2026-11-10",
  "expected_delivery_date": "2026-11-13",
  "delivery_fee": 1250.5,
  "currency": "NGN",
  "additional_instructions": "Call the buyer on arrival."

request.description: Administrator assigns an approved, available transporter whose coverage includes the delivery location.
Administrator reassigns an assigned or accepted delivery.
Advance the delivery lifecycle. Transporter: picked_up, in_transit, delivered, failed (with reason). Buyer/admin: completed, cancelled.
